# JetBrains Mono

The reading canvas uses JetBrains Mono, the typeface used in Chuanqi Sun’s Spaceship IDE. The six normal-weight variable WOFF2 subsets in this directory are unmodified files from Fontsource’s 5.3.0 distribution. The browser loads the subsets required for the transcript. [JetBrains Mono](https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono) · [Spaceship IDE](https://github.com/chuanqisun/spaceship) · [Fontsource distribution](https://registry.npmjs.org/@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono/-/jetbrains-mono-5.3.0.tgz)

The original copyright and SIL Open Font License 1.1 accompany the fonts in [OFL.txt](OFL.txt). For a reproducible copy, use the files matching `package/files/*-wght-normal.woff2` and the `package/LICENSE` file from the distribution. The CSS declarations in `ui/src/assets/jetbrains-mono.css` come from its `package/wght.css` with local asset URLs.
